reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for International Partnerships

title.narrative: Activity under preparation Strengthening social cohesion, including dispute resolution

description.narrative: The Action will contribute to strengthen social cohesion in Sri Lanka by fostering a peaceful and inclusive society and by strengthening cooperation amongst its diverse communities and promote Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) mechanisms through mediation. Social cohesion is essential for sustainable growth and a lasting peace, both of which are enablers for possible future investments in line with the EU Global Gateway strategy. To this end, the Action will build upon the results of the EU funded projects of the past years in both the reconciliation and mediation sectors, as well as on economic development, and it will be complementary to the ongoing action in the justice sector, by working at both national and local level on different components to:a)    support effective national integration policies and fight mis/dis-information through the provision of evidence-based information for policy making and public discourse;b)    support national truth-seeking reconciliation processes and mechanisms, and intercommunal dialogue;c)    provide support for the full deployment and operationalisation nation-wide of the ¿Special Land and Special Financial Mediation Boards¿, thus contributing to structural change to strengthen the rule of law and the efficiency of the justice system in Sri Lanka, by contributing to reduce structural courts cases¿ backlog;d)    strengthen local authorities capacity to identify and promote economic development , and create and/or strengthen opportunities for it through intercommunal cooperation in selected provinces, i.e. those most affected by the civil war and where EU efforts will build on the work carried out in the past (North and East provinces).Therefore, the Overall Objective of the Action is to foster a more tolerant, peaceful, cohesive society in Sri Lanka.The Specific Objectives are: 1)to address exclusion and intolerance in Sri Lanka, with a specific focus on women and youth;2)to strengthen access to justice and efficiency of the justice system on land and small financial disputes;to support intercommunal economic cooperation and economic inclusion with a focus on women and youth.
